title: [Pmt. Recon. Journal] Re-fire OnAfterGetLedgEntryInfo on proposal fast path
summary: The OnAfterGetLedgEntryInfo event is re-fired during payment proposal creation on the fast path after a prior performance refactor accidentally stopped raising it.
key_points: Re-fires OnAfterGetLedgEntryInfo event for Customer, Vendor, Employee, and Bank Account entries
Uses a temporary round-trip mechanism without additional ledger reads
Restores event subscriptions that update proposal fields
Low risk change that restores pre-refactoring behavior
quote: Re-fire the legacy event via a temp round-trip (no second ledger read) so existing subscribers keep updating proposal fields.
